The '''Republic transport shuttle''' was a class of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], transporting troops and civilians to various worlds.

The ship was propelled by two engines, attached to folding wings, on each sides. Most of the hull was used to transport passengers, with the cockpit protruding on the back. A ramp could be extended rearward of the ship to give access to the passenger compartment, sheltered by an armored door. To protect itself, the shuttle was equipped with two twin [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]]: one in the front of the ship, right under the nose; and one on the back, right in front of the cockpit.

One shuttle delivered new recruits to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], and another shuttle was used by the Republic archaeological team that explored the planet [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]]. Several shuttles that were part of [[Strike Team Oricon]] crashed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Republic_Transport_Shuttle_Concept_Art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|republic shuttle concept art]]
According to a concept art by [[Ryan Dening]] from 2010 with the mention "player flown ship", it is possible that the shuttle was planned as a player ship at some point for the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The ship was used in the game as a generic transport for the Republic.
